LESSON: USING OUR SENSES TO IDENTIFY FOOD

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.3: Using our senses to identify food

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Using our senses to identify food. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Using our senses to identify food
2. Give Kenyan examples for Using our senses to identify food
3. Practise Using our senses to identify food at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: USING OUR SENSES TO IDENTIFY FOOD
This lesson teaches Using our senses to identify food for Grade 1 HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING

Example 1: Describe Using our senses to identify food using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

2. Explain Using our senses to identify food to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Using our senses to identify food.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Using our senses to identify food with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Using our senses to identify food important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.
